note: LITTERPOSTING: a solo, unhinged, meme-tier cat rant narrated by STRAY, one of the Meowizens. Not a two-actor conversation — just the cat, off its leash. Hit the button to hear it read aloud.

turns.text: NEKOCORP just auto-drafted my rent in $CLAWCOIN while i was asleep in a dumpster and i need everyone to sit with that for a second. i did not consent. i was DREAMING. about tuna. i woke up owing them my THIRD LIFE and a staking penalty. OH MY NEUTER.

for the strays just tuning in: they launched a COIN. a nekocorp COIN. pegged to your loyalty tier. so now if you hiss at a patrol drone your credit score AND your net worth tank at the same damn time. based? no. this is the single most corpo cuck move they have ever pulled and i've watched them tax rain.

they VESTED my nine lives. with a CLIFF. i gotta stay alive-and-loyal for four whole years before life #4 even unlocks. i do not have four years. i barely have four HOURS. i am a gutter animal with a wallet i never asked for. HOLY CAT PISS.

and here's the part nobody wants to hear — a coin is just a leash you can't see. they didn't tokenize the tuna. they tokenized the WANTING. every cat on this feed is farming loyalty points for a fridge that will never love them back, and calling it freedom. ...anyway. rent's due. where was i.

VALENTUNA — married to an actual smart refrigerator, blackpilled beyond repair — even SHE read the $CLAWCOIN whitepaper and said it scans like a hostage note. when the FRIDGE thinks it's dystopian, mewmew, it is dystopian. that's the whole review. print it on the kiosk.

they handed me a card that literally says TIER: NONE. NONE. negative tier. i'm so far under bronze i'm in the dirt with the meowchuds and i STILL somehow owe unstaking fees. explain that to my face. you can't. because it's fake. it's a number that goes up so a corpo cat in Neko Sky District can buy a bigger sunbeam. that's the whole coin. that's the whole city.

so no. i will not be buying the dip. i will not be improving my loyalty tier. i will be shitting behind the vending machine that charges a subscription for WATER and i will be doing it for FREE. that's the only economy i trust. the streets don't take a cut. the gutter has never rug-pulled me once.

unstake your lives. delete your tier. come be broke and free out here in the gutter with the rest of us. the war was never on the feed, chuds — it's in the LITTERBOX. TUNA OF THE GODS to whichever kitten pisses on the $CLAWCOIN kiosk first. that's a bounty. and unlike theirs, that one's real.
